_doc: Tracked files that commands legitimately write in the MAIN checkout (personalization, not framework development).
mode 'config': allowed only while .agents/state/mode says config (python3 tools/set_mode.py config). The config
commands (/setup, /reset, /expand, /add-portal, /add-template) switch it on at their start and back to operator at the end.
mode 'always': operator flows write it by design, so it is allowed in any mode.
Drift check (check_framework_immutable.py), any mode: 'drift_exempt' true = never drift (profile/config docs);
'lines' = exempt only if every changed line vs HEAD matches 'lines'; 'new_dir' = exempt only untracked files inside a
brand-new <dir_depth>-segment directory with no tracked files (a portal/template just created by /add-portal|/add-template).
'lines' (optional regex): the 'always' grant only covers edits whose changed lines ALL match it; any other change
falls back to the remaining rules (normally config-only). Globs: '*' stays inside one path segment, '**' crosses them.
Every other tracked file, and every new non-ignored file under a framework dir, is denied in the main checkout:
file an issue with tools/report_issue.py or work in a linked git worktree.

paths.why: Facts confirmed during /apply or /interview must reach the profile in the same turn or the grounding audit strips them later.
/interview is an operator flow and appends STAR examples on explicit user request.

used_by: /scrape offers to set a broken portal's enabled: false (job-scraper/SKILL.md:235)
paths.why: Only the enabled: toggle line; any other change to a portal skill is framework work.
